scripts.format:check: npm --prefix frontend run format:check && npm --prefix backend run format:check
scripts.build: npm run format:check && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.prod:start: if [ ! -f backend/dist/backend/src/main.js ]; then npm --prefix backend run build; fi; npm --prefix backend run start:prod
scripts.prod:stop: if command -v fuser >/dev/null 2>&1; then fuser -k 3000/tcp 2>/dev/null || true; elif command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1; then lsof -ti tcp:3000 | xargs -r kill; fi
scripts.stop:dev: if command -v fuser >/dev/null 2>&1; then fuser -k 3000/tcp 2>/dev/null || true; elif command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1; then lsof -ti tcp:3000 | xargs -r kill; fi
scripts.stop:backend:dev: if command -v fuser >/dev/null 2>&1; then fuser -k 5000/tcp 2>/dev/null || true; elif command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1; then lsof -ti tcp:5000 | xargs -r kill; fi
